dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Highly irregular, jagged light-toned perimeters forming interconnected 'O' and 'C' shapes across the central flank; the gradient is sharpest at the outer perimeter transition from dark background to light structural outlines.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters; small, localized pixel groups without internal gradients are restricted to the cranial and caudal transition zones.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the five most prominent mid-body annuli form an elongated, asymmetrical pentagonal network oriented along the dorsal-ventral axis.
